name: Signal Fires
weather: storm bands: heavy squalls with clear breaks
timeOfDay: one long night, dusk to dawn
designIntent: The planetwide uprising ignites: one long night mission with three targets — fuel farm, drone hangar, checkpoint chain — under dynamic reinforcements as the whole coast rises.

briefing.speaker: Relay
briefing.text: Something happened when Rauk fell. The word went down the coast, then up the karst, then everywhere — and tonight every cell, every quarry crew, every dockhand with a cutting torch is coming out at once. This is the night, Lodestar. The uprising. Command — such as we are without her — has picked three targets that decide whether it lives past sunrise. One: the Greel fuel farm. Burn it and Directorate armor on this coast dies of thirst. Two: the drone hangar at Point Istra. Every airframe in it will be over the crowds by morning if we let it fly. Three: the checkpoint chain on the arcology highway. Crack it open and the coast pours toward Vell. Order's yours, routes are yours, the night is long. The Directorate will feed reinforcements at every target the moment you're committed, so watch your heat and watch your people. Light the signal fires. She'll see them from her cell. I believe that.

objectives.title: Drain the Farm
objectives.description: Destroy the Greel fuel farm's storage spheres.

objectives.title: Ground the Drones
objectives.description: Destroy the drone hangar at Point Istra before its launch cycles complete.

objectives.title: Open the Highway
objectives.description: Crack the three checkpoint fortresses of the arcology highway chain.

objectives.title: Shelter the Rising
objectives.description: Relieve a Compact cell pinned down along your route between targets.

enemyForces: Fuel-farm garrison: turret belts and a Halite pair
Drone hangar at Point Istra launching escalating drone waves the longer it stands, screened by a Chert fire-support pair
Checkpoint chain: pop-up turret fortresses, Ferric platoons, and a Basalt anchor
Dynamic reinforcement columns (Gabbro and Halite mixes) dispatched toward whichever target the player commits to
Strafing aircraft in the clear breaks between squalls
setPieces: Signal fires ignite on the ridgelines one by one as the uprising spreads, visible from anywhere on the map
The fuel farm goes up in a chained sphere detonation that lights the underside of the storm
Drone waves launch in real time from the hangar as it counts through its launch cycles
Kryce's counter-broadcast plays over captured checkpoint speakers, growing more ragged as the night turns
Dawn breaks over the opened highway as Compact columns roll past with horns sounding
failConditions: The drone hangar completes all of its launch cycles
Any primary target still stands at dawn
salvageNotes: The best salvage night of the campaign: reinforcement columns keep feeding mechs into your guns. Legged Gabbros and Halites along your chosen route can be flagged for the Compact columns following behind. The hangar's spare-parts stores survive only if it dies before its third launch cycle.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Watch the ridgelines. The cells are lighting signal fires as they rise — that's your map of who's already fighting.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Directorate reserve column dispatched toward your position. The night has noticed you.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: Storage spheres cracked — get back, get BACK — ...HAAA! Look at it burn! You can see that from orbit!

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: Hangar doors opening — launch cycle starting! Whatever you're going to do, do it before those things are over Marrow Bay!

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Drone wave airborne. Swarm-rack lock solutions available.

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Checkpoint guns are automated. The crews already ran. Good sign.

voTriggers.speaker: Kryce
voTriggers.line: Citizens. Order is not negotiable. The Directorate has weathered tantrums before. Return to your homes, and this night will be... forgotten.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: More columns moving — they're pulling garrisons off the karst to plug the coast. It's working. The whole planet is pulling them apart.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Damage critical. The uprising does not require your destruction to succeed. Withdraw and re-approach.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Heat redline approaching. You have been firing for a long time, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Sun's coming up. Highway's open, farm's ash, drones are grounded. Signal fires the whole length of the coast. If she's at a window... she sees them.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: TO VELL! To the Anchor! We're coming, Commander — the whole coast is coming!
